decisions.decision: Phase 05.3 owns the generic observation data-flow foundation and feedback baseline; Phase 05.4 owns the heavy faction-ship proof across X4 and Rust; Phase 05.5 owns only station-specific remainder.
decisions.rationale: Generic mechanisms must remain source-agnostic while ships and stations act only as conformance examples.

decisions.decision: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md documents target behavior, docs/architecture-decisions.md owns ADRs, docs/architecture-verification.md owns evidence and probes, and .planning owns delivery state.
decisions.rationale: Architecture documentation must not become a mixed decision transcript, status report, and plan dump.

decisions.decision: X4 API research is owned by the separate Docs MCP repository and must preserve immutable snapshot provenance.
decisions.rationale: Live Galaxy consumes researched API evidence rather than rebuilding a competing game-API corpus locally.

The target is a continuous bounded observation stream with separate collection and transport state machines, source-agnostic scheduling, independent section revisions, stop-and-wait receiver feedback as the baseline, carrier A behind a neutral facade, evidence-triggered carrier B, exact retry identity, bounded keyed Rust candidates, completion certificates, and atomic publication. Do not copy old Live MCP limits or the existing Phase 05.1 numbers into production policy.
